rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a tournament or competitive event when the exact format is not important.

example.english: There's a tournament this Saturday; let's go watch it if we're free.
example.traditional: 今個星期六有個比賽，得閒一齊去睇吓啦。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 luk6 jau5 go3 bei2 coi3 dak1 haan4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 haa5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for a tournament contested to win a championship or title.

example.english: Our team finally won the tournament this year.
example.traditional: 我哋隊今年終於贏咗錦標賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 gam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 jeng4 zo2 gam2 biu1 coi3

rows.note: Use this for a knockout tournament in which losing teams or players are eliminated.

example.english: The knockout tournament starts tomorrow; if you lose one game, you are out.
example.traditional: 聽日開始淘汰賽，輸一場就冇得再打。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 hoi1 ci2 tou4 taai3 coi3 syu1 jat1 coeng4 zau6 mou5 dak1 zoi3 daa2

rows.note: Use this for a league-style tournament in which teams or players meet over a series of fixtures.

example.english: There are three games left in the tournament this season, and our team needs every point.
example.traditional: 今季聯賽仲有三場，我哋隊要全力爭分。
